title: Detailed treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- shadow under chest -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="38" ry="7" fill="#3a1f0e"/>

  <!-- chest base (wood) -->
  <rect x="12" y="52" width="76" height="30" rx="4" fill="#a0522d"/>
  <rect x="12" y="52" width="76" height="30" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#d2691e" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- wood grain lines on base -->
  <line x1="18" y1="58" x2="82" y2="58" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="66" x2="82" y2="66" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="74" x2="82" y2="74" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- lid (domed) -->
  <path d="M12 52 Q12 28 50 28 Q88 28 88 52 Z" fill="#c4733a"/>
  <path d="M12 52 Q12 28 50 28 Q88 28 88 52 Z" fill="none" stroke="#e8a060" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- lid wood grain -->
  <path d="M20 46 Q50 32 80 46" fill="none" stroke="#a0522d" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M22 40 Q50 28 78 40" fill="none" stroke="#a0522d" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- metal bands vertical on base -->
  <rect x="22" y="52" width="6" height="30" fill="#d4a830"/>
  <rect x="22" y="52" width="6" height="30" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="72" y="52" width="6" height="30" fill="#d4a830"/>
  <rect x="72" y="52" width="6" height="30" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- metal bands on lid -->
  <path d="M22 52 Q22 34 28 30" fill="none" stroke="#d4a830" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M22 52 Q22 34 28 30" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 52 Q72 34 66 30" fill="none" stroke="#d4a830" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 52 Q72 34 66 30" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- horizontal metal band across middle -->
  <rect x="12" y="50" width="76" height="5" fill="#d4a830"/>
  <rect x="12" y="50" width="76" height="5" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- lock plate -->
  <rect x="42" y="52" width="16" height="18" rx="3" fill="#e8c040"/>
  <rect x="42" y="52" width="16" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#fff080" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- keyhole -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="3" fill="#7a5a10"/>
  <rect x="48.5" y="61" width="3" height="6" fill="#7a5a10" rx="1"/>

  <!-- hinges left -->
  <rect x="10" y="48" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="#d4a830"/>
  <rect x="10" y="48" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="52" r="2" fill="#fff080"/>

  <!-- hinges right -->
  <rect x="80" y="48" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="#d4a830"/>
  <rect x="80" y="48" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="52" r="2" fill="#fff080"/>

  <!-- gold coins spilling from top right -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="36" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f5d030"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="36" rx="5" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#fff080" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="32" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5d030"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="32" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#fff080" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="34" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5d030"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="34" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#fff080" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="28" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#f5d030"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="28" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="none" stroke="#fff080" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- gem on lid -->
  <polygon points="50,34 54,38 50,42 46,38" fill="#40e0d0"/>
  <polygon points="50,34 54,38 50,42 46,38" fill="none" stroke="#a0fff0" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- corner decorations -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="78" r="3" fill="#f0d060"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="78" r="3" fill="#f0d060"/>
</svg>
